entities.summary: Freedom Park is a park situated on Salvokop in Pretoria. It includes a memorial with a list of the names of those killed in the South African Wars, World War I, World War II as well as during the apartheid era. Freedom Park is a military museum in Africa, established in 2004. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
